data.notes: The report gets the core story right. It surfaces the payback request about a month before the freeze as the turning point, contradicts the rep's 'nothing we could have done', and turns all four expected messaging directions into evidenced changes (drop the revenue framing, build the customer's own number, a cost-of-status-quo story for the CFO, a staged-migration reference). Its biggest misses are structural. It tags the deal 'Value proof' instead of 'No decision' and gives no acceptable runner-up.
